what_happened: The dispatch DOCSTRING REQUIREMENT says to record that the other three classes 'remain task 412's', but C9 of check-module-invariants.sh asserts zero task-number citations under FormalSystem/, and no-task-references-in-deliverables.md forbids them outright. Research substitutes durable anchors (Verified/README.md's Provable.lean row; Correctness.lean's 'Retired as vacuous' section) and flags the substitution for the implementer.

A single lean_run_code probe re-verified all three composing declarations by #check AND compiled the full corollary in its proposed final namespace/open set, returning its exact #print axioms line [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -- so the C14 baseline value is known before any file is written, with no lake build.

Plan deliberately departs from the dispatch's suggested placement (Compression/Assembly.lean or a sibling under WitnessFamily/Compression/) in favour of FormalSystem/Metalogic/ZTimeProvability.lean, on the research report's measured import-weight evidence (+331/+318 vs +2 net-new transitive imports; no cycle in any option). Also departs from the dispatch's DOCSTRING REQUIREMENT wording ('remain task 412's'), which C9 and no-task-references-in-deliverables.md forbid under FormalSystem/; three verified durable anchors substituted.

Research had already compiled both declarations in situ and measured their axiom sets, and the gate script's own comment block pre-authorizes the exact C14 edit shape. Planning needed no new exploration beyond confirming anchors still resolve; the plan could pin exact terms, exact heredoc anchors and the exact failure mode (decidable_of_iff direction) rather than leaving them to discovery.

The pre-commit typst-sync-check gate (Check 2) refuses a commit that adds a .lean file under FormalSystem/ without the matching FormalSystem.lean import line and a regenerated typst/generated/status.typ. Plan Phase 1 was specified as its own commit (per-substep), but Phase 1 alone is uncommittable: the gate compares 652 import lines against 653 .lean files. Phases 1 and 2 are therefore committed together, with typst-sync-check.sh --fix run in the same change set.

Phase 2's scope hypothesis asserted exactly two import-line insertions in two files. Adding a .lean file under FormalSystem/ additionally invalidates three machine-generated README inventory blocks (README.md, FormalSystem/README.md, FormalSystem/Metalogic/README.md) and typst/generated/status.typ. Both are regenerated, not hand-edited: 'check-module-invariants.sh --emit-inventory' and 'typst-sync-check.sh --fix'. The +2 net-new transitive import measurement itself held: the aggregator-plus-MainResults build was incremental (2760 jobs, 1.6s for the new module) and cycle-free.
